scope: Nine base batches, nine completed 20M panels (including three audit-expansion queries) and ninety-three new followup singleton queries: prior seventy-one plus twenty-two Batch 09. Twenty-two Batch 09 reuse entries identify twenty-one unique played queries already counted in the original panel. Mac, pilots and abandoned transition costs remain separate.
limits: Measured VM lifetimes priced at recorded rate, not billing. Mean scaling only; panel sizes, discovered alternatives and availability vary. Inclusive scenarios retain ancillary storage/transfer/operations and recovery assumptions. Cloud-stage timing excludes preflight, retrieval, review pauses and final synthesis.

calendar_estimate.games_and_batch_analysis: Friday evening, approximately 20:00–22:00 CET under stated assumptions
calendar_estimate.final_independently_reviewed_diagnosis: Friday night–Saturday morning, approximately Friday 22:00–Saturday 03:00 CET centrally; extended review may use more of Saturday morning
calendar_estimate.basis: The final 20 games and their panel have a measured-mean cloud estimate of 2.77 hours. Current Batch 09 followup and audit expansion have completed. Add assumed 0.6–1.2 hours for remaining preflight/retrieval/verification and 0.5–1.5 hours for batch review and any final-batch followup: roughly 4–6 hours through batch completion from this snapshot. Then allow 2–4 hours for final synthesis and independent challenge. Larger recent panels and capacity variability require uncertainty; these are assumptions, not guarantees.
calendar_estimate.uncertainty: New alternatives, regional stockouts or substantive final-review findings can extend these windows; no coverage is truncated to meet an ETA.
